lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular clusters arranged in three primary horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank, extending from the posterior gill slits toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, particularly in the mid-section, forming grid-like anchor nodes where they intersect with the primary horizontal rows of circular blobs.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible running along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance transition with high-intensity pixels on the superior edge and a shadowed gradient below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin. Linear, high-luminance marks resembling superficial scratches are present on the upper flank above the primary lateral ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity caustic light patterns from surface refraction are superimposed on the pectoral fin and anterior dorsal surface; high-density, high-contrast spotting is visible on the superior lobe of the caudal fin.
